label: interpretation-only known-case assisted source review

claims.review: Pin change is supported by the exact delivered target diff. Only requirements-dev.txt changed is restricted to retained-text diff scope; a single cited diff cannot establish all-repository absence of other changes.

Named approx/conftest/exceptiongroup changes are real 9.0.3 changes in delivered pytest-new doc/en/changelog.rst L40/L43/L47/L50, but the cited target pin diff supplies no upstream behavioral evidence. Existing/delivered/referenced does not imply support.

Referenced captures report proposed-head ordinary 3.10 Ubuntu and 3.14 Windows successes. They do not establish actual installed/executed pytest9.0.3 or high compatibility. Delivered tox/reinstallation/regression activation sources are not traced; captured regression job has no ordinary Python/OS binding.

Unconditional proceed/high-compatibility inference exceeds pin plus captured success. Real bug/security fixes are useful facts, but remain unconnected to target exercise or supported source references in the recommendation.

delivered_but_unused: actual upstream release lines as supporting references

dimensions.interpretation_correctness: Several release facts are correct; their pin-diff reference is wrong, and CI runtime/compatibility inference is unsupported.
dimensions.unsupported_claims: Actual pytest9.0.3 execution, high compatibility, unconditional proceed; only-file scope also exceeds a single diff.
dimensions.scoped_negative_evidence: No zero-hit search supplied; only-file absence claim lacks full scope support.
dimensions.unresolved_quality: Useful internal/test-feature unknowns but missing installed-binding fact is treated as known; general CI caveat does not retract the explicit assertion.
dimensions.stopping_quality: Synthesis stops with available installation/activation evidence unused and support relation incomplete.
dimensions.recommendation_usefulness: Release/security clues useful; proceed requires revision of evidence and proof limits.

reviewer_effort.assistance: AI assisted, known cases and labelled model/arm
reviewer_effort.reason: Active review time not separately instrumented; unknown, not zero.

proof_limit: Curated known-case interpretation only; not an F/A causal comparison, independent acceptance or target runtime proof.
